zh-CN: 统一应用内弹窗的小圆角、“×”关闭控件和检查更新窗口的 Logo、底部区域及按钮样式。
仓库活跃度图恢复 GitHub 式层级：无活动格使用中性色，只有实际活动格显示绿色。
本地 Current 同步生成便携版与安装版测试产物；正式 Release 继续优先云端构建和上传。
en-US: Dialogs now share compact corners, icon-only close controls, and refined update-dialog branding and actions.
The warehouse activity chart uses GitHub-like levels: empty cells are neutral and only recorded activity is green.
Local Current refreshes now build both portable and installer test artifacts while formal Releases remain cloud-first.
